subject: function that passes object to shiny app, then return modified version of object

messages.author: 1384d5b2e3f82159
messages.subject: function that passes object to shiny app, then return modified version of object
parts:
I'm hoping to include a shiny app in an R package I'm writing and I'd like to know if the following idea is possible. Can I write a function that takes an object as input, launches the shiny app, allows the user to manipulate the object using the functionality of the app, and then the function returns the modified version of the object? In pseudo-code, something like:

run_shiny_app <- function(object) {
  1. launches app
  2. object is available to be manipulated by user using the functionality of the app
  3. when user closes the app the function returns the modified version of object
}

Is this possible? If so I can't figure it out.
